description: Look up an animal at Sonoma County Animal Services by id, name, or breed. Use in_shelter_only=true to answer "is there a [breed] at the shelter right now" / "is there a lost husky at Sonoma County animal services" — an animal with no outcome yet is still in the shelter.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

in_shelter_only.description: If true, only return animals that have not yet had an outcome (still at the shelter). Default false (returns full intake/outcome history).

name: sonoma_search_animal
title: Sonoma Search Animal
